description: We are a motivated team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge in Tunis. We are passionate about technology, space, creativity, and using innovative solutions to address real-world challenges.
summary:
Alpha Orbit is a NASA-powered agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to climate volatility, water scarcity, soil degradation, and changing growing conditions. Farmers can draw or select land parcels on an interactive map and receive environmental diagnostics based on NASA POWER weather data, satellite imagery, SoilGrids soil information, terrain data, and FAO-56 agronomic methods.

The platform evaluates land health, temperature stress, evapotranspiration, soil moisture, rainfall, slope, and crop suitability across a catalogue of more than 30 crops. It compares conventional and adaptive crop rotations, estimates water and fertilizer savings, and simulates the effects of a +2°C warming scenario. Farmers can save and switch between multiple parcels, view optional 10-day weather alerts and weather forecast. Alpha Orbit is designed to support local farmers, agronomists, extension services, and field measurements
details: Alpha Orbit is a farmer-focused agricultural decision-support platform that uses NASA and open environmental data to help farmers adapt to climate change, water scarcity, soil degradation, and unpredictable weather. Farmers can draw or select land parcels on an interactive map, after which the system analyzes location, area, terrain slope, soil conditions, rainfall, temperature, evapotranspiration, soil moisture, and vegetation indicators. It ranks more than 30 crops, identifies potential risks, recommends adaptive crop rotations, estimates water and fertilizer savings, and simulates how a +2°C warming scenario could affect crop performance. The platform also supports multiple saved lands, optional 10-day weather alerts, interactive charts, and downloadable PDF action reports. It was developed with Python, FastAPI, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Leaflet, Chart.js, jsPDF, Shapely, PyProj, NumPy, Rasterio, and related geospatial libraries. Its creative value comes from translating complex NASA Earth-observation and agronomic data into clear, practical decisions while combining long-term climate planning with short-term field actions. Alpha Orbit is designed to improve farm resilience, sustainability, water management, and profitability while supporting local agricultural knowledge and expert advice.
